The '''Crseih system''' in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] contained the [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Crseih]] and a [[Crseih black hole|black hole]]. It was at one time the location of [[Crseih Station]].
